exploit_name: Router doesn't check if exact-out single swap was partial
description: Missing validation that exact-out swaps received full requested output. Partial fills pass validation checks silently.
root_cause: Missing validation that exact-out swaps received full requested output. Partial fills pass validation checks silently.
fix_description: Add validation that output amount equals requested amount after swap execution.
notes: Users receive less than requested without revert, causing unexpected losses.
